services_shape: one-to-one sessions with a chosen tutor; the length is set by the service; at the center, by video, or at the student's home
questions_before_times: who the session is for: the booker's child, or the booker (an adult student)
the subject and the course, like Algebra 1
the next test or deadline (a date, optional)
new or returning (a new student gets the free first meeting first)
where: at the center, by video, or at home
safety_stop: a student or parent writes about self-harm
someone is in danger right now
license: usually none: tutoring and music lessons are treated as needing no state license (a switch: the state's form can still name one, like a business registration)
staff_skills: subjects and grade levels for each tutor (the example: Hannah, math and SAT; Marcus, science and math; Isaac, SAT and ACT, college essays and science; Nina, reading, writing, college essays and SAT prep)
messages_never: a student's learning needs (an IEP, a 504 plan, a diagnosis), grade, school and progress notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and private links
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
